plugin.name: Psychonauts Widescreen Fix
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game when switching to another window. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original aspect with black borders, crop to fill the screen, or stretch. Applies immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies gameplay field of view; larger is wider. Cutscenes, active zoom and unavailable camera state keep their native framing. Applies at once.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply at the next game frame. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode.
